package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"
)

func TestUpdateTaskLearningTargetsDistinguishesOmittedAndExplicitEmpty(t *testing.T) {
	var omitted UpdateTaskRequest
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{}`), &omitted); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode omitted request: %v", err)
	}
	if omitted.LearningTargets != nil {
		t.Fatal("omitted learning_targets must preserve stored targets")
	}

	var explicitEmpty UpdateTaskRequest
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"learning_targets":[]}`), &explicitEmpty); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode explicit empty request: %v", err)
	}
	if explicitEmpty.LearningTargets == nil || len(*explicitEmpty.LearningTargets) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("explicit empty learning_targets must request target removal")
	}
}
